title: A workflow can look finished.
voice: A workflow can look finished and still lose an enquiry. Foundry helps a training provider turn that hidden risk into something they can test.

title: Two pass. Three failures surface.
voice: This walkthrough uses a prepared sample, not live model generation. Build the enquiry workflow and run five fixed scenarios. The baseline passes two. Three everyday problems are exposed.

title: Expected versus observed.
voice: Open the duplicate test. The contract expects one record and a review warning. The baseline accepts two records. This evidence comes from the same engine that powers the form.

title: Review a bounded repair.
voice: Foundry proposes bounded rule changes. A person reviews the changes before applying them. The repair cannot rewrite the tests or regress an already passing scenario.

title: Same contract. Five pass.
voice: Apply the repair and rerun. All five scenarios now pass. The unassigned enquiry is visible again. The evidence compares versions using the same expectations.

title: The form follows the rules.
voice: These are working controls. An enquiry with a missing email cannot be saved. Duplicate review and date validation also apply to the form. Results can be exported as JSON.

title: Working proof. Visible limits.
voice: This is a constrained training enquiry prototype with synthetic data. The Nebius adapter targets NVIDIA Nemotron. Live inference awaits account activation. Foundry makes the difference between a proposal and proof visible.
